Infrastructure owners need safer, smarter ways to understand the condition of their physical assets, and that’s why they work with CC Informatics. 

We capture comprehensive photographic datasets from hard‑to‑access environments and apply advanced machine‑vision analytics to extract the insight engineers need for maintenance, regulatory compliance and long‑term asset management. 

At the core of our capability is AssetScan, our proprietary machine‑vision technology that turns raw imagery into mapped, measurable deterioration data. Whether on image data that has been captured or provided, AssetScan automatically detects and classifies defects, anchors findings within digital twins, and enables automated change detection across repeat surveys. By replacing the heavy lifting of data processing and feature identification with technology, AssetScan gives clients faster, clearer and more reliable insight, helping engineers make confident maintenance decisions, improve safety outcomes and manage ageing infrastructure with greater consistency and control.

Porque a influência não começa quando alguém decide seguir você, mas quando você decide ser quem é e, assim, atrai as pessoas certas.

Companies forget. Decisions live in Slack threads, meeting recordings, reports, and the heads of people who already left. Mithrandir makes that memory permanent and puts it to work.

We parse your company’s history into a knowledge graph and link every decision to the conversation that explains why it’s decided. Your AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, internal agents) plug in and answer with full company context. No extra clicks.

Around that core, every conversation, decision, and document your company produces is captured and connected. Every team, every tool, one memory. Sales calls, board decks, and financial reports... All live in the same graph, connected through context, bridged to your technical core. Ready for agents to dive in.

One brain for everyone does not mean everyone sees everything. Access control is enforced in the graph itself. Content a user isn't cleared for never reaches the model. Not a prompt filter, a structural guarantee.

When people leave, their reasoning stays. Permanently.

Ask "why does this workaround exist?" and get the commit, the debate, and who made the call. In seconds.

Backed by ongoing research at Carnegie Mellon.

The only brain that knows tech.
